name: Crush Their Spirits

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: One foe or many, you can break their morale all the same. When you demoralize, you can target up to 2 creatures within 30 feet of you. If you're a master in Intimidation, you can Demoralize up to 4 creatures instead, or 8 creatures if you're legendary.
